culture-cycles.note: Holidays treated like Sundays under the cantonal rest-day laws (SECO table). The 1 August national day is the only federal holiday. Holidays on a Sunday are not moved.

laws.rule: Since 1 October 2024, federal law has set a single minimum age of 18 across Switzerland for the sale of tobacco products and electronic cigarettes, including vending machines and online sales (Tobacco Products Act, art. 23). This canton follows that national rule. If staff are in doubt about a buyer's age, they should check it with an official photo identity document that shows a date of birth.
